2	"""Strategy Arena orchestrator (entry point: arena-run).
3	
4	Runs multiple DailyStrategy implementations through one pipeline:
5	
6	  arena-run backtest  — walk-forward every selected strategy over the same
7	                        window, apply the universal filter bar (lenient by
8	                        design: it screens out clear losers only), persist
9	                        PASS/EXCLUDED with metrics. Excluded strategies stay
10	                        visible in the report — never silently dropped.
11	  arena-run live      — one paper-trading tick per surviving strategy:
12	                        recompute signals over recent history and append any
13	                        equity/trade rows newer than the last recorded date.
14	                        Deterministic strategies + INSERT OR IGNORE make this
15	                        idempotent and self-backfilling after missed days.
16	  arena-run report    — side-by-side comparison table, unranked.
17

19	arena_state/arena.db by default. Each strategy has its own independent
20	paper ledger; there is no shared capital pool.

87	def _iso(d) -> str:
88	    """Normalize a pandas Timestamp / datetime / date to YYYY-MM-DD."""

92	def _ensure_column(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str, ddl: str) -> None:
93	    """Idempotently add a column to an existing table (in-place migration).
94	
95	    ``CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`` only helps brand-new databases — an
96	    arena.db created before a schema change needs its own ALTER. Guarded on
97	    PRAGMA table_info so re-running is always safe.
98	    """
99	    cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
100	    if column not in cols:
101	        conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {ddl}")
102	        conn.commit()

105	class ArenaState:
106	    """SQLite persistence for the arena's backtest verdicts and live ledgers."""
107	
108	    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
109	        parent = os.path.dirname(db_path)
110	        if parent:
111	            os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
112	        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
113	        self.conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
114	        self.conn.commit()
115	        _ensure_column(self.conn, "strategies", "sizing", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equal'")
116	        _ensure_column(self.conn, "strategies", "hwm_anchor", "TEXT")
117	
118	    def record_backtest(self, name: str, status: str, metrics: dict,
119	                        sizing: str = "equal") -> None:
120	        """Upsert a strategy's filter verdict, backtest metrics, and sizing mode.
121	
122	        Sizing is screened configuration: whatever mode a strategy is
123	        screened under is what ``arena-run live`` reuses for it — a live
124	        track record never silently switches sizing regimes mid-stream.
125	        """
126	        self.conn.execute(
127	            "INSERT INTO strategies(name,status,backtest_sharpe,backtest_cagr,backtest_maxdd,sizing,updated) "
128	            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,date('now')) "
129	            "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status, "
130	            "backtest_sharpe=excluded.backtest_sharpe, backtest_cagr=excluded.backtest_cagr, "
131	            "backtest_maxdd=excluded.backtest_maxdd, sizing=excluded.sizing, updated=excluded.updated",
132	            (name, status, metrics.get("Sharpe"), metrics.get("CAGR"), metrics.get("MaxDD"), sizing),
133	        )
134	        self.conn.commit()
135	
136	    def statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
137	        """{strategy name: PASS | EXCLUDED} for every strategy seen in backtest."""
138	        return dict(self.conn.execute("SELECT name, status FROM strategies"))
139	
140	    def sizing_mode(self, name: str) -> str:
141	        """Stored sizing mode for a strategy; 'equal' if never screened (legacy)."""
142	        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT sizing FROM strategies WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
143	        return row[0] if row and row[0] else "equal"
144	
145	    def last_equity(self, name: str) -> Tuple[str, float] | None:
146	        """(date, equity) of the newest recorded live bar, or None if fresh."""
147	        row = self.conn.execute(
148	            "SELECT date, equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
149	            (name,),
150	        ).fetchone()
151	        return (row[0], float(row[1])) if row else None
152	
153	    def append_ledger(self, name: str, equity_rows: List[tuple],
154	                      trade_rows: List[tuple]) -> int:
155	        """Idempotently append (date, equity) and trade rows; returns rows added."""
156	        cur = self.conn.executemany(
157	            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO equity(strategy,date,equity) VALUES(?,?,?)",
158	            [(name, d, e) for d, e in equity_rows],
159	        )
160	        added = cur.rowcount
161	        self.conn.executemany(
162	            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trades(strategy,date,ticker,position,confidence,weight,fwd_ret,reason) "
163	            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
164	            [(name, *t) for t in trade_rows],
165	        )
166	        self.conn.commit()
167	        return added
168	
169	    def log_gap(self, name: str, date: str, cause: str) -> None:
170	        """Record a skipped strategy-day (data failure etc.) without crashing the run."""
171	        self.conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gaps(strategy,date,cause) VALUES(?,?,?)",
172	                          (name, date, cause))
173	        self.conn.commit()
174	
175	    def set_status(self, name: str, status: str) -> None:
176	        """Force a strategy's status (used by the circuit breaker to PAUSE/un-PAUSE)."""
177	        self.conn.execute("UPDATE strategies SET status=? WHERE name=?", (status, name))
178	        self.conn.commit()
179	
180	    def anchor(self, name: str) -> str | None:
181	        """The strategy's high-water-mark anchor date, or None (full history)."""
182	        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT hwm_anchor FROM strategies WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
183	        return row[0] if row else None
184	
185	    def set_anchor(self, name: str, date: str) -> None:
186	        """Move the high-water-mark anchor — resume resets drawdown tracking here."""
187	        self.conn.execute("UPDATE strategies SET hwm_anchor=? WHERE name=?", (date, name))
188	        self.conn.commit()
189	
190	    def running_drawdown(self, name: str) -> Tuple[float, float, float] | None:
191	        """(drawdown, peak_equity, current_equity) since the anchor date.
192	
193	        Drawdown is the last recorded equity vs. the highest equity observed
194	        since the anchor (anchor NULL ⇒ full history). Returns None when
195	        fewer than 2 equity rows exist in the anchored window — no drawdown
196	        is defined yet.
197	        """
198	        anchor = self.anchor(name)
199	        if anchor is None:
200	            rows = self.conn.execute(
201	                "SELECT equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? ORDER BY date", (name,)
202	            ).fetchall()
203	        else:
204	            rows = self.conn.execute(
205	                "SELECT equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? AND date>=? ORDER BY date",
206	                (name, anchor),
207	            ).fetchall()
208	        values = [r[0] for r in rows]
209	        if len(values) < 2:
210	            return None
211	        peak = max(values)
212	        current = values[-1]
213	        return (current / peak - 1.0), peak, current
214	
215	    def log_breaker_event(self, name: str, date: str, event: str, drawdown: float | None,
216	                          peak_equity: float | None, equity: float | None,
217	                          threshold: float | None) -> None:
218	        """Record a TRIP or RESUME transition. Idempotent per (strategy, date, event)."""
219	        self.conn.execute(
220	            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO breaker_events(strategy,date,event,drawdown,peak_equity,equity,threshold) "
221	            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
222	            (name, date, event, drawdown, peak_equity, equity, threshold),
223	        )
224	        self.conn.commit()

227	def passes_filter(metrics: dict, min_sharpe: float, max_dd: float) -> bool:
228	    """Universal (strategy-agnostic) backtest bar.
229	
230	    Lenient by design — Sharpe must clear min_sharpe and max drawdown must
231	    stay above max_dd (both defaults screen out only clear losers; the live
232	    arena does the real comparison).
233	    """
234	    sharpe = metrics.get("Sharpe")
235	    maxdd = metrics.get("MaxDD")
236	    if sharpe is None or maxdd is None:
237	        return False
238	    return sharpe > min_sharpe and maxdd >= max_dd

241	def build_strategy(name: str, gbm_bundle: str | None) -> DailyStrategy:
242	    """Construct a registered strategy, wiring the GBM bundle path when needed."""
243	    if name == "gbm":
244	        if not gbm_bundle:
245	            raise SystemExit("strategy 'gbm' requires --gbm_bundle <model_bundle.joblib>")
246	        return get_strategy(name, bundle_path=gbm_bundle)
247	    return get_strategy(name)

250	def live_tick(state: ArenaState, name: str, strategy: DailyStrategy,
251	              data: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame], top_n: int, capital: float,
252	              trade_cost_bps: float, sizing: str = "equal",
253	              max_pos: float = 0.30, vol_window: int = 20,
254	              cost_model: CostModel | None = None,
255	              since_date: str | None = None) -> int:
256	    """One live paper-trading step for one strategy over pre-fetched data.
257	
258	    Recomputes the walk-forward over the fetched window, then appends only
259	    rows newer than the last recorded date, chaining equity multiplicatively
260	    from the stored value. Because strategies are deterministic given data,
261	    a missed week self-heals on the next run, and re-running the same day is
262	    a no-op (PRIMARY KEY + INSERT OR IGNORE).
263	
264	    ``sizing`` should be the mode the strategy was screened under
265	    (``ArenaState.sizing_mode``) — callers should not pick an arbitrary mode
266	    for a strategy already trading live.
267	
268	    ``since_date``, when given, additionally floors the append cutoff (in
269	    effect: ``max(last_recorded_date, since_date)``). This is how a resumed
270	    strategy avoids retroactively "trading" through the window it was
271	    paused for — passing the resume date here means the paused gap's price
272	    action is neither credited nor charged; the ledger simply picks back up
273	    from the first bar after resume. No-op for a strategy that was never
274	    paused (``since_date=None``, the default).
275	
276	    Returns the number of new equity rows appended.
277	    """
278	    eq, blotter = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=top_n,
279	                                           capital=capital,
280	                                           trade_cost_bps=trade_cost_bps,
281	                                           sizing=sizing, max_pos=max_pos,
282	                                           vol_window=vol_window,
283	                                           cost_model=cost_model)
284	    if eq.empty:
285	        state.log_gap(name, _iso(dt.date.today()), "no data in fetched window")
286	        return 0
287	
288	    # The window's final bar is provisional: its own forward return doesn't
289	    # exist yet, so storing it now would permanently miss that return once
290	    # the next bar arrives. Drop it — the next run records it fully realized.
291	    eq = eq.iloc[:-1]
292	    if eq.empty:
293	        return 0
294	
295	    # Per-bar growth factors are scale-free, so they chain onto any stored
296	    # equity regardless of what `capital` the recompute started from.
297	    factors = eq["equity"] / eq["equity"].shift(1)
298	    factors.iloc[0] = eq["equity"].iloc[0] / capital
299	
300	    last = state.last_equity(name)
301	    if last is None and since_date is None:
302	        new = eq
303	        chained = eq["equity"]
304	    else:
305	        last_date, last_equity = last if last is not None else (None, capital)
306	        cutoff = last_date
307	        if since_date is not None and (cutoff is None or pd.Timestamp(since_date) > pd.Timestamp(cutoff)):
308	            cutoff = since_date
309	        mask = eq.index > pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
310	        new = eq[mask]
311	        if new.empty:
312	            return 0
313	        chained = factors[mask].cumprod() * last_equity
314	
315	    equity_rows = [(_iso(d), float(v)) for d, v in chained.items()]
316	    new_dates = {_iso(d) for d in new.index}
317	    trade_rows = []
318	    if not blotter.empty:
319	        for _, r in blotter.iterrows():
320	            if _iso(r["date"]) in new_dates:
321	                trade_rows.append((_iso(r["date"]), r["ticker"], int(r["position"]),
322	                                   float(r["confidence"]), float(r["weight"]),
323	                                   float(r["fwd_ret"]), r["reason"]))
324	    return state.append_ledger(name, equity_rows, trade_rows)
325

327	def _parse_names(arg: str) -> List[str]:
328	    """Split and validate a comma-separated strategy list."""
329	    names = [s.strip() for s in arg.split(",") if s.strip()]
330	    unknown = [n for n in names if n not in available_strategies()]
331	    if unknown:
332	        raise SystemExit(f"unknown strategies: {', '.join(unknown)} "
333	                         f"(available: {', '.join(available_strategies())})")
334	    return names

337	def _cost_model_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> CostModel:
338	    """Build a CostModel from the shared --cost_model/--*_bps CLI flags."""
339	    return CostModel(mode=args.cost_model, flat_bps=args.trade_cost_bps,
340	                     commission_bps=args.commission_bps,
341	                     half_spread_bps=args.half_spread_bps,
342	                     impact_coeff_bps=args.impact_coeff_bps,
343	                     fallback_adv=args.fallback_adv)

346	def cmd_backtest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
347	    """Backtest all selected strategies over one window and apply the filter."""
348	    from paper_trading_sim import fetch_history  # local: network-touching import
349	
350	    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
351	    data = fetch_history(tickers, args.start, args.end)
352	    state = ArenaState(args.db)
353	    cost_model = _cost_model_from_args(args)
354	    rows = []
355	    for name in _parse_names(args.strategies):
356	        strategy = build_strategy(name, args.gbm_bundle)
357	        eq, _ = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=args.top_n,
358	                                         capital=args.capital,
359	                                         sizing=args.sizing, max_pos=args.max_pos,
360	                                         vol_window=args.vol_window,
361	                                         cost_model=cost_model)
362	        metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity"]) if not eq.empty else {}
363	        gross_metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity_gross"]) if not eq.empty else {}
364	        total_cost = float(eq["cost"].sum()) if not eq.empty else 0.0
365	        ok = passes_filter(metrics, args.min_sharpe, args.max_dd)
366	        status = "PASS" if ok else "EXCLUDED"
367	        state.record_backtest(name, status, metrics, sizing=args.sizing)
368	        rows.append({"strategy": name, "status": status,
369	                     "sharpe": metrics.get("Sharpe"), "cagr": metrics.get("CAGR"),
370	                     "maxdd": metrics.get("MaxDD")})
371	        print(f"{name:12s} {status:8s} sharpe={metrics.get('Sharpe', float('nan')):.2f} "
372	              f"cagr(net)={metrics.get('CAGR', float('nan')):.2%} "
373	              f"cagr(gross)={gross_metrics.get('CAGR', float('nan')):.2%} "
374	              f"maxdd={metrics.get('MaxDD', float('nan')):.2%} "
375	              f"total_cost=${total_cost:,.2f}")
376	    excluded = [r["strategy"] for r in rows if r["status"] == "EXCLUDED"]
377	    if excluded:
378	        print(f"\nExcluded from live trading (bar: sharpe>{args.min_sharpe}, "
379	              f"maxdd>={args.max_dd:.0%}): {', '.join(excluded)}")
380

382	def cmd_live(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
383	    """Run one live paper-trading tick for every PASS strategy."""
384	    from paper_trading_sim import fetch_history  # local: network-touching import
385	
386	    state = ArenaState(args.db)
387	    statuses = state.statuses()
388	    names = _parse_names(args.strategies) if args.strategies else \
389	        [n for n, s in statuses.items() if s == "PASS"]
390	    if not names:
391	        raise SystemExit("no PASS strategies in the arena DB — run `arena-run backtest` first")
392	
393	    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
394	    start = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=args.lookback_days)).isoformat()
395	    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
396	    for name in names:
397	        if statuses.get(name) != "PASS":
398	            print(f"{name}: skipped (status={statuses.get(name, 'never backtested')})")
399	            continue
400	        if name == "gbm" and not args.gbm_bundle:
401	            print("gbm: skipped — pass --gbm_bundle to run it live")
402	            continue
403	        try:
404	            data = fetch_history(tickers, start, None)
405	            strategy = build_strategy(name, args.gbm_bundle)
406	            mode = state.sizing_mode(name)
407	            anchor = state.anchor(name)
408	            added = live_tick(state, name, strategy, data, args.top_n,
409	                              args.capital, args.trade_cost_bps, sizing=mode,
410	                              max_pos=args.max_pos, vol_window=args.vol_window,
411	                              cost_model=_cost_model_from_args(args),
412	                              since_date=anchor)
413	            print(f"{name}: {added} new day(s) recorded (sizing={mode})")
414	
415	            if not args.no_breaker:
416	                dd_info = state.running_drawdown(name)
417	                if dd_info is not None:
418	                    drawdown, peak, current = dd_info
419	                    threshold = -abs(args.breaker_dd)
420	                    if drawdown <= threshold:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strategy Arena orchestrator (entry point: arena-run).

Runs multiple DailyStrategy implementations through one pipeline:

  arena-run backtest  — walk-forward every selected strategy over the same
                        window, apply the universal filter bar (lenient by
                        design: it screens out clear losers only), persist
                        PASS/EXCLUDED with metrics. Excluded strategies stay
                        visible in the report — never silently dropped.
  arena-run live      — one paper-trading tick per surviving strategy:
                        recompute signals over recent history and append any
                        equity/trade rows newer than the last recorded date.
                        Deterministic strategies + INSERT OR IGNORE make this
                        idempotent and self-backfilling after missed days.
  arena-run report    — side-by-side comparison table, unranked.

State lives in SQLite (stdlib sqlite3 — no new dependency) under
arena_state/arena.db by default. Each strategy has its own independent
paper ledger; there is no shared capital pool.

See .claude/plans/strategy-arena.md for the full design.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import os
import sqlite3
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

import pandas as pd

from analyze_equity import compute_metrics
from costs import CostModel
from strategies.daily import DailyStrategy
from strategies.registry import available_strategies, get_strategy
from walkforward_sim import parse_tickers, run_strategy_walkforward

DEFAULT_DB = os.path.join("arena_state", "arena.db")

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strategies (
  name            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status          TEXT NOT NULL,            -- PASS | EXCLUDED
  backtest_sharpe REAL,
  backtest_cagr   REAL,
  backtest_maxdd  REAL,
  updated         TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equity (
  strategy TEXT NOT NULL,
  date     TEXT NOT NULL,
  equity   REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades (
  strategy   TEXT NOT NULL,
  date       TEXT NOT NULL,
  ticker     TEXT NOT NULL,
  position   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL,
  weight     REAL,
  fwd_ret    REAL,
  reason     TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date, ticker)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gaps (
  strategy TEXT NOT NULL,
  date     TEXT NOT NULL,
  cause    TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS breaker_events (
  strategy    TEXT NOT NULL,
  date        TEXT NOT NULL,
  event       TEXT NOT NULL,   -- TRIP | RESUME
  drawdown    REAL,
  peak_equity REAL,
  equity      REAL,
  threshold   REAL,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date, event)
);
"""


def _iso(d) -> str:
    """Normalize a pandas Timestamp / datetime / date to YYYY-MM-DD."""
    return pd.Timestamp(d).date().isoformat()


def _ensure_column(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str, ddl: str) -> None:
    """Idempotently add a column to an existing table (in-place migration).

    ``CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`` only helps brand-new databases — an
    arena.db created before a schema change needs its own ALTER. Guarded on
    PRAGMA table_info so re-running is always safe.
    """
    cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
    if column not in cols:
        conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {ddl}")
        conn.commit()


class ArenaState:
    """SQLite persistence for the arena's backtest verdicts and live ledgers."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        parent = os.path.dirname(db_path)
        if parent:
            os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        self.conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
        self.conn.commit()
        _ensure_column(self.conn, "strategies", "sizing", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equal'")
        _ensure_column(self.conn, "strategies", "hwm_anchor", "TEXT")

    def record_backtest(self, name: str, status: str, metrics: dict,
                        sizing: str = "equal") -> None:
        """Upsert a strategy's filter verdict, backtest metrics, and sizing mode.

        Sizing is screened configuration: whatever mode a strategy is
        screened under is what ``arena-run live`` reuses for it — a live
        track record never silently switches sizing regimes mid-stream.
        """
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO strategies(name,status,backtest_sharpe,backtest_cagr,backtest_maxdd,sizing,updated) "
            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,date('now')) "
            "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status, "
            "backtest_sharpe=excluded.backtest_sharpe, backtest_cagr=excluded.backtest_cagr, "
            "backtest_maxdd=excluded.backtest_maxdd, sizing=excluded.sizing, updated=excluded.updated",
            (name, status, metrics.get("Sharpe"), metrics.get("CAGR"), metrics.get("MaxDD"), sizing),
        )
        self.conn.commit()

    def statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """{strategy name: PASS | EXCLUDED} for every strategy seen in backtest."""
        return dict(self.conn.execute("SELECT name, status FROM strategies"))

    def sizing_mode(self, name: str) -> str:
        """Stored sizing mode for a strategy; 'equal' if never screened (legacy)."""
        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT sizing FROM strategies WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row and row[0] else "equal"

    def last_equity(self, name: str) -> Tuple[str, float] | None:
        """(date, equity) of the newest recorded live bar, or None if fresh."""
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT date, equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (name,),
        ).fetchone()
        return (row[0], float(row[1])) if row else None

    def append_ledger(self, name: str, equity_rows: List[tuple],
                      trade_rows: List[tuple]) -> int:
        """Idempotently append (date, equity) and trade rows; returns rows added."""
        cur = self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO equity(strategy,date,equity) VALUES(?,?,?)",
            [(name, d, e) for d, e in equity_rows],
        )
        added = cur.rowcount
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trades(strategy,date,ticker,position,confidence,weight,fwd_ret,reason) "
            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            [(name, *t) for t in trade_rows],
        )
        self.conn.commit()
        return added

    def log_gap(self, name: str, date: str, cause: str) -> None:
        """Record a skipped strategy-day (data failure etc.) without crashing the run."""
        self.conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gaps(strategy,date,cause) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                          (name, date, cause))
        self.conn.commit()

    def set_status(self, name: str, status: str) -> None:
        """Force a strategy's status (used by the circuit breaker to PAUSE/un-PAUSE)."""
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE strategies SET status=? WHERE name=?", (status, name))
        self.conn.commit()

    def anchor(self, name: str) -> str | None:
        """The strategy's high-water-mark anchor date, or None (full history)."""
        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT hwm_anchor FROM strategies WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def set_anchor(self, name: str, date: str) -> None:
        """Move the high-water-mark anchor — resume resets drawdown tracking here."""
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE strategies SET hwm_anchor=? WHERE name=?", (date, name))
        self.conn.commit()

    def running_drawdown(self, name: str) -> Tuple[float, float, float] | None:
        """(drawdown, peak_equity, current_equity) since the anchor date.

        Drawdown is the last recorded equity vs. the highest equity observed
        since the anchor (anchor NULL ⇒ full history). Returns None when
        fewer than 2 equity rows exist in the anchored window — no drawdown
        is defined yet.
        """
        anchor = self.anchor(name)
        if anchor is None:
            rows = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? ORDER BY date", (name,)
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? AND date>=? ORDER BY date",
                (name, anchor),
            ).fetchall()
        values = [r[0] for r in rows]
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        peak = max(values)
        current = values[-1]
        return (current / peak - 1.0), peak, current

    def log_breaker_event(self, name: str, date: str, event: str, drawdown: float | None,
                          peak_equity: float | None, equity: float | None,
                          threshold: float | None) -> None:
        """Record a TRIP or RESUME transition. Idempotent per (strategy, date, event)."""
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO breaker_events(strategy,date,event,drawdown,peak_equity,equity,threshold) "
            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (name, date, event, drawdown, peak_equity, equity, threshold),
        )
        self.conn.commit()


def passes_filter(metrics: dict, min_sharpe: float, max_dd: float) -> bool:
    """Universal (strategy-agnostic) backtest bar.

    Lenient by design — Sharpe must clear min_sharpe and max drawdown must
    stay above max_dd (both defaults screen out only clear losers; the live
    arena does the real comparison).
    """
    sharpe = metrics.get("Sharpe")
    maxdd = metrics.get("MaxDD")
    if sharpe is None or maxdd is None:
        return False
    return sharpe > min_sharpe and maxdd >= max_dd


def build_strategy(name: str, gbm_bundle: str | None) -> DailyStrategy:
    """Construct a registered strategy, wiring the GBM bundle path when needed."""
    if name == "gbm":
        if not gbm_bundle:
            raise SystemExit("strategy 'gbm' requires --gbm_bundle <model_bundle.joblib>")
        return get_strategy(name, bundle_path=gbm_bundle)
    return get_strategy(name)


def live_tick(state: ArenaState, name: str, strategy: DailyStrategy,
              data: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame], top_n: int, capital: float,
              trade_cost_bps: float, sizing: str = "equal",
              max_pos: float = 0.30, vol_window: int = 20,
              cost_model: CostModel | None = None,
              since_date: str | None = None) -> int:
    """One live paper-trading step for one strategy over pre-fetched data.

    Recomputes the walk-forward over the fetched window, then appends only
    rows newer than the last recorded date, chaining equity multiplicatively
    from the stored value. Because strategies are deterministic given data,
    a missed week self-heals on the next run, and re-running the same day is
    a no-op (PRIMARY KEY + INSERT OR IGNORE).

    ``sizing`` should be the mode the strategy was screened under
    (``ArenaState.sizing_mode``) — callers should not pick an arbitrary mode
    for a strategy already trading live.

    ``since_date``, when given, additionally floors the append cutoff (in
    effect: ``max(last_recorded_date, since_date)``). This is how a resumed
    strategy avoids retroactively "trading" through the window it was
    paused for — passing the resume date here means the paused gap's price
    action is neither credited nor charged; the ledger simply picks back up
    from the first bar after resume. No-op for a strategy that was never
    paused (``since_date=None``, the default).

    Returns the number of new equity rows appended.
    """
    eq, blotter = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=top_n,
                                           capital=capital,
                                           trade_cost_bps=trade_cost_bps,
                                           sizing=sizing, max_pos=max_pos,
                                           vol_window=vol_window,
                                           cost_model=cost_model)
    if eq.empty:
        state.log_gap(name, _iso(dt.date.today()), "no data in fetched window")
        return 0

    # The window's final bar is provisional: its own forward return doesn't
    # exist yet, so storing it now would permanently miss that return once
    # the next bar arrives. Drop it — the next run records it fully realized.
    eq = eq.iloc[:-1]
    if eq.empty:
        return 0

    # Per-bar growth factors are scale-free, so they chain onto any stored
    # equity regardless of what `capital` the recompute started from.
    factors = eq["equity"] / eq["equity"].shift(1)
    factors.iloc[0] = eq["equity"].iloc[0] / capital

    last = state.last_equity(name)
    if last is None and since_date is None:
        new = eq
        chained = eq["equity"]
    else:
        last_date, last_equity = last if last is not None else (None, capital)
        cutoff = last_date
        if since_date is not None and (cutoff is None or pd.Timestamp(since_date) > pd.Timestamp(cutoff)):
            cutoff = since_date
        mask = eq.index > pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
        new = eq[mask]
        if new.empty:
            return 0
        chained = factors[mask].cumprod() * last_equity

    equity_rows = [(_iso(d), float(v)) for d, v in chained.items()]
    new_dates = {_iso(d) for d in new.index}
    trade_rows = []
    if not blotter.empty:
        for _, r in blotter.iterrows():
            if _iso(r["date"]) in new_dates:
                trade_rows.append((_iso(r["date"]), r["ticker"], int(r["position"]),
                                   float(r["confidence"]), float(r["weight"]),
                                   float(r["fwd_ret"]), r["reason"]))
    return state.append_ledger(name, equity_rows, trade_rows)


def _parse_names(arg: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split and validate a comma-separated strategy list."""
    names = [s.strip() for s in arg.split(",") if s.strip()]
    unknown = [n for n in names if n not in available_strategies()]
    if unknown:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown strategies: {', '.join(unknown)} "
                         f"(available: {', '.join(available_strategies())})")
    return names


def _cost_model_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> CostModel:
    """Build a CostModel from the shared --cost_model/--*_bps CLI flags."""
    return CostModel(mode=args.cost_model, flat_bps=args.trade_cost_bps,
                     commission_bps=args.commission_bps,
                     half_spread_bps=args.half_spread_bps,
                     impact_coeff_bps=args.impact_coeff_bps,
                     fallback_adv=args.fallback_adv)


def cmd_backtest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Backtest all selected strategies over one window and apply the filter."""
    from paper_trading_sim import fetch_history  # local: network-touching import

    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
    data = fetch_history(tickers, args.start, args.end)
    state = ArenaState(args.db)
    cost_model = _cost_model_from_args(args)
    rows = []
    for name in _parse_names(args.strategies):
        strategy = build_strategy(name, args.gbm_bundle)
        eq, _ = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=args.top_n,
                                         capital=args.capital,
                                         sizing=args.sizing, max_pos=args.max_pos,
                                         vol_window=args.vol_window,
                                         cost_model=cost_model)
        metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity"]) if not eq.empty else {}
        gross_metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity_gross"]) if not eq.empty else {}
        total_cost = float(eq["cost"].sum()) if not eq.empty else 0.0
        ok = passes_filter(metrics, args.min_sharpe, args.max_dd)
        status = "PASS" if ok else "EXCLUDED"
        state.record_backtest(name, status, metrics, sizing=args.sizing)
        rows.append({"strategy": name, "status": status,
                     "sharpe": metrics.get("Sharpe"), "cagr": metrics.get("CAGR"),
                     "maxdd": metrics.get("MaxDD")})
        print(f"{name:12s} {status:8s} sharpe={metrics.get('Sharpe', float('nan')):.2f} "
              f"cagr(net)={metrics.get('CAGR', float('nan')):.2%} "
              f"cagr(gross)={gross_metrics.get('CAGR', float('nan')):.2%} "
              f"maxdd={metrics.get('MaxDD', float('nan')):.2%} "
              f"total_cost=${total_cost:,.2f}")
    excluded = [r["strategy"] for r in rows if r["status"] == "EXCLUDED"]
    if excluded:
        print(f"\nExcluded from live trading (bar: sharpe>{args.min_sharpe}, "
              f"maxdd>={args.max_dd:.0%}): {', '.join(excluded)}")


def cmd_live(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Run one live paper-trading tick for every PASS strategy."""
    from paper_trading_sim import fetch_history  # local: network-touching import

    state = ArenaState(args.db)
    statuses = state.statuses()
    names = _parse_names(args.strategies) if args.strategies else \
        [n for n, s in statuses.items() if s == "PASS"]
    if not names:
        raise SystemExit("no PASS strategies in the arena DB — run `arena-run backtest` first")

    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
    start = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=args.lookback_days)).isoformat()
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    for name in names:
        if statuses.get(name) != "PASS":
            print(f"{name}: skipped (status={statuses.get(name, 'never backtested')})")
            continue
        if name == "gbm" and not args.gbm_bundle:
            print("gbm: skipped — pass --gbm_bundle to run it live")
            continue
        try:
            data = fetch_history(tickers, start, None)
            strategy = build_strategy(name, args.gbm_bundle)
            mode = state.sizing_mode(name)
            anchor = state.anchor(name)
            added = live_tick(state, name, strategy, data, args.top_n,
                              args.capital, args.trade_cost_bps, sizing=mode,
                              max_pos=args.max_pos, vol_window=args.vol_window,
                              cost_model=_cost_model_from_args(args),
                              since_date=anchor)
            print(f"{name}: {added} new day(s) recorded (sizing={mode})")

            if not args.no_breaker:
                dd_info = state.running_drawdown(name)
                if dd_info is not None:
                    drawdown, peak, current = dd_info
                    threshold = -abs(args.breaker_dd)
                    if drawdown <= threshold:
                        state.set_status(name, "PAUSED")
                        state.log_breaker_event(name, today, "TRIP", drawdown, peak, current, threshold)
                        print(f"  !! BREAKER TRIPPED for {name}: drawdown {drawdown:.2%} "

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import math
import pandas as pd


def compute_metrics(eq: pd.Series) -> dict:
    eq = eq.dropna()
    if len(eq) < 2:
        return {"error": "Not enough data"}

    initial, final = float(eq.iloc[0]), float(eq.iloc[-1])
    total_return = final / initial - 1.0

    ret = eq.pct_change().dropna()
    n = len(ret)
    ann = 252.0

    cagr = (final / initial) ** (ann / max(1.0, n)) - 1.0
    vol = float(ret.std()) * math.sqrt(ann) if n else 0.0
    apr_simple = float(ret.mean()) * ann if n else 0.0
    sharpe = (float(ret.mean()) * ann) / vol if vol > 0 else 0.0

    cum = (1.0 + ret).cumprod()
    roll_max = cum.cummax()
    maxdd = float((cum / roll_max - 1.0).min()) if len(cum) else 0.0

    years = n / ann

    return {
        "Initial": initial,
        "Final": final,
        "TotalReturn": total_return,
        "Years(approx)": years,
        "CAGR": cagr,
        "APR_simple": apr_simple,
        "Vol": vol,
        "Sharpe": sharpe,
        "MaxDD": maxdd,
    }


def compare_strategies(conn) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build the arena's side-by-side comparison table from a SQLite connection.

    One row per strategy ever backtested, deliberately unranked (the human
    picks the winner). EXCLUDED strategies keep their backtest metrics and
    appear with empty live columns — visible, never silently dropped.
    ``sharpe_divergence`` (live minus backtest) is the overfitting canary:
    a strategy that collapses live relative to its backtest is suspect even
    if its absolute numbers still look fine.

    Args:
        conn: sqlite3 connection to an arena_state DB (tables: strategies,
            equity, trades — see strategy_arena.py).

    Returns:
        DataFrame with columns strategy, status, live_sharpe, live_cagr,
        live_maxdd, win_rate, trades, backtest_sharpe, sharpe_divergence,
        paused_since (latest circuit-breaker TRIP date, only when currently PAUSED).
    """
    strategies = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM strategies", conn)
    equity = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM equity", conn, parse_dates=["date"])
    trades = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM trades", conn)
    latest_trips = pd.read_sql_query(
        "SELECT strategy, MAX(date) AS date FROM breaker_events WHERE event='TRIP' GROUP BY strategy",
        conn,
    ).set_index("strategy")["date"].to_dict()

    rows = []
    for _, s in strategies.iterrows():
        name = s["name"]
        eq = (equity[equity["strategy"] == name]
              .set_index("date")["equity"].sort_index())
        live = compute_metrics(eq) if len(eq) >= 2 else {}
        t = trades[trades["strategy"] == name].dropna(subset=["fwd_ret"])
        wins = int(((t["position"] * t["fwd_ret"]) > 0).sum())
        n_trades = int(len(t))
        live_sharpe = live.get("Sharpe")
        bt_sharpe = s["backtest_sharpe"]
        divergence = (live_sharpe - bt_sharpe
                      if live_sharpe is not None and pd.notna(bt_sharpe) else None)
        rows.append({
            "strategy": name,
            "status": s["status"],
            "live_sharpe": live_sharpe,
            "live_cagr": live.get("CAGR"),
            "live_maxdd": live.get("MaxDD"),
            "win_rate": wins / n_trades if n_trades else None,
            "trades": n_trades,
            "backtest_sharpe": bt_sharpe,
            "sharpe_divergence": divergence,
            "paused_since": latest_trips.get(name) if s["status"] == "PAUSED" else None,
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Compute portfolio performance metrics from an equity CSV")
    p.add_argument("--equity_csv", type=str, default="walkforward_equity.csv", help="Path to equity CSV (date index, column 'equity')")
    args = p.parse_args()

    df = pd.read_csv(args.equity_csv, index_col=0, parse_dates=True)
    if "equity" not in df.columns:
        raise SystemExit("CSV must contain an 'equity' column")

    m = compute_metrics(df["equity"])        
    for k, v in m.items():
        if isinstance(v, float):
            if k in ("TotalReturn", "CAGR", "APR_simple", "Vol", "Sharpe", "MaxDD"):
                # Print returns/vol as percents except Sharpe
                if k == "Sharpe":
                    print(f"{k}: {v:.2f}")
                else:
                    print(f"{k}: {v:.2%}")
            else:
                print(f"{k}: {v:.4f}")
        else:
            print(f"{k}: {v}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
